notes.title: Demo is back!
notes.notes: [h1][b]Changes:[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b]The Demo is back live, [/b]save progress from the demo will count towards the main game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]When the ant nests get destroyed then now damage enemies that are in range.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Some slight changes to how crate launch physics are calculated, [/b]we had some instances where no upwards force was being applied to the crate making it fall through the ground.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Missing Health clips had a rework,[/b] they were calculating of an incorrect base value so bigger clips were getting faster reloads than smaller clips at low health values, but then at critical health they were slower.[/p][/*][*][p][b]In relation to above the reload UI has been adjusted, [/b]now when a reload is faster the UI it will start at the correct point, e.g. if you are reloading 50% faster the UI will start at 50%.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Removed sounds from the tiny explosions,[/b] it was creating a spike in the amount of sounds getting played because they almost always fire quickly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added a UI pop-up if the game picks up a corrupted save, [/b]hopefully no one should ever see this but it's an extra catch just in case something weird happens to the active save file.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Bug fixes:[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b]Fixed the tutorial level not triggering the correct initialisation of VFX managers on certain systems. [/b]this would bug out the tutorial for some people.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed FPS changes in options menu,[/b] when we were making changes for the Steam Deck we accidentally overwrote the base values every time,[/p][/*][*][p][b]The speed up fire rate melee barrel types had missing SFX, [/b]now they have the correct sounds when activating, we also changed them to reset the counter each hit so it should be more powerful.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The arrow pointing to the next level transition will hide itself when the level up UI is active.[/b][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 7
notes.notes: [h1][b]Additions:[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b]New Store images and assets, [/b]looks flash now.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added in walls around large nests, [/b]now the large level transition nests have destructible walls surrounding them, the nests containing flies also have a couple of walls around them so it easy to tell them apart.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New rock types to level 3 and 4, [/b]these rocks are taller than the previous ones, you can jump over them with certain balls.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added some new UI icons to the upgrade cards, [/b]with the new icons you can tell at a glance what type a part is or how big the bullets are.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Bug fixes:[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b]Ricochet bullets weren't resetting their bounces correctly,[/b] now the rarer bounce type bullets should bounce more often, also fixed rotation on the ones that split on critical hit.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed burst core types not firing after moving to a new level, [/b]there was an issue where the burst would stop mid transition and wouldn't allow you to fire the gun again until it was reloaded or rebuilt.[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Balance changes:[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b]Increased damage for the fire ball bullets by 25%.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Increased damage on shot-gun type bullets 15-30%.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Some name changes to certain legendary bullets to help tell them apart.[/b][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 6 - End Game
notes.notes: [h1][b]Final Level:[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b]The ant queen has been found! [/b]This level is very small compared to the other levels that let you explore around a lot more. The queen sits in the centre, she can summon walls and enemies around her to help defend her.[/p][/*][*][p][b]To get to this level you'll need to find some large walled ant nests in the Caverns.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936824/bf9751cb3195951feec40d4d866429c255e01247.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]New Balls:[/h1][list][*][p][b]Barrage ball, [/b]this new ball stops you in place and slows down time but doubles your fire rate and instantly reloads your guns, it's hard to get working but when it does you can be unstoppable.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cyber Ball, [/b]Slows time and allows you to move around and reposition while still firing your guns, (It's a Sandevistan, shh don't tell CDPR)[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936824/d2eb300dbb20b8a2852a2f2d0309110cbbabdf98.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]More Additions:[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b]Added in unlocked flies to the inner ball, [/b]now after finding flies in the levels they'll show up in the inner ball. flies actually have 5 different ranks too, later levels give better flies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New ball selection menu, [/b]this allows us to add more balls down the line much easier than our last menu which kind of had a limit to how many balls we could have in the menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Web Warden Legendary barrel, [/b]the only quad barrel in the game, also has huge penetration.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New small nest on Surface level, [/b]this nest only spawns the basic blue ants, still gives an EXP magnet and has a poop pile tho.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hints to the loading screen.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Bug fixes:[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b]Mini gun type barrels now show correct RPM, [/b]there was a bug that was reverting the fire rate when the UI was active.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI Scaling on some menus, [/b]some menus on certain screen sizes we cutting off 3D elements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Text was blurry on some UI canvases. [/b]Finally found and fixed this issue, now all the text looks crisp.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Localisation fixes, [/b]adjusted scaling on UI text to be more consistent between localisations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed a rare high damage bug, [/b]where if you took too much damage it would bypass all the attached guns on the ball killing you instantly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Save Data back-up files, [/b]gives us a way to recover from a corrupted save due to upload issues or an overwrite problem.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Eggs we're getting destroyed correctly,[/b] we accidently introduced a bug last patch that wasn't stopping the dropped eggs from hatching.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Optimisation:[/h1][list][*][p][b]VFX management, [/b]we've optimised all the VFX so now we can have huge amounts of blood and guts left behind after killing waves of ants.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemy pooling, [/b]we've made some optimisations to the way enemies are reused, should cut down on lag spikes when there are huge amounts of enemies spawning.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Game data, [/b]even with a whole new level and enemies we've managed to keep the game at 525mb[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemy animations, [/b]we changes some of the animations to run at different frame rates so the CPU isn't having to work as hard.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Explosive force optimisation, [/b]now when there are heaps of explosions going off there are less calculations done on the CPU for applying the force.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Balance changes:[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b]Increased damage for some large bullet types. [/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Rarity changes to a couple of gun parts.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Stuff for next update:[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b]Level 3 'Caverns' boss.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Some more UI adjustments.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Hidden levels???[/b][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Week Five Patch!
notes.notes: [h1]Additions:[/h1][list][*][p][b]Custom shadows for enemies, [/b]makes the enemies easier to spot when they are in shadows but also increases their contrast when it lit areas, and allows us to remove them from the standard light layer getting us a small performance advantage to boot.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rollo is animated!!! [/b]re-wrote Rollo's animation manager, now he turns and strafes with the ball, also has a new run animation when the ball is at max speed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added a new trap type to the levels, [/b]there are explosive traps on the levels now, but they don't damage you just the enemies, they will launch you up into the air though, can get you out of tricky situations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fly cages now have a chance to spawn inside fire nests, [/b]the fly cages are still getting tweaked and aren't final, we want to add special mechanics to free the flies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Loading screen,[/b] added a very simple loading screen for between levels and fixed a couple of backend bugs that were popping up on scene transitions (also looks better).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Health ball mesh and effects, [/b]there is a new health ball and effects have been fixed up.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shield ball, [/b]the shield ball has had a rework now too, [/p][/*][*][p][b]Bunch of new sound effects and bullet effects.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Huge amount of backend optimisation changes,[/b] we've managed to get the game file size down to 500mb!!! which is huge!!! or not huge, small!!![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Bug fixes:[/h1][list][*][p][b]Effect laser wasn't spawning it area effect, [/b]there are a couple of rare blue laser types that can spawn a static explosion on crit, the code was dependant on an old system that was made redundant months ago, now it works... and can be very powerful.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed kill counters scale going negative, [/b]when getting lots of kills very quickly there was a chance the kill counter scale would get swapped to negative values, but now if you are getting heaps of kills over a short period of time the scale can get really huge, we could cap the scale but it's kinda funny right now so we're leaving it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed a rare bug where quitting a run while in the upgrade menu would cause the upgrade menu to break on the next run.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed enemy rigidbody mass[/b], some small enemies had higher mass values than larger enemies, (this is separate to the bullet penetration mass check), it was causing larger enemies to be pushed around by smaller enemies, or the other way around.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed audio not playing on overkill effect.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed the correct manufactures lists getting populated when swapping weapons factories from storage.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed UI scaling for Steam deck and ultra wide monitors, [/b]now the new UI will look more consistent on various monitor sizes.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Balance changes:[/h1][list][*][p][b]Increased effectiveness of most large and extra large bullet types[/b], they have had their damage increased by 15-25%.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Massively increased effectiveness of damage over time effects[/b], added 2 extra ticks and doubled the speed at which it affects the enemies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Buffed magnet range from EXP magnet factories, [/b]we realised they weren't as good to upgrade as just getting better efficiency.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lots of adjustments to epic and legendary parts, [/b]some parts weren't nearly as good as others and felt underwhelming for such high level parts, bunch of cores have had their damage increased or boosted crit damage. there are weapon builds that can now hit crit damage values of over 40K :D[/p][/*][*][p][b]Changed the Re-roll behaviour slightly, [/b]now after upgrading a gun it locks the re-roll so you can't keep upgrading the same gun, we'd like to hear feedback on this, this current system was how we planned to do it but isn't as strong as it was before.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Stuff for next update:[/h1][list][*][p][b]Final level and final bosses, [/b]we have models and animation in now for the final boss, we just have to polish and fix the final level. the ant Queen is not far away and will be a significant threat.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936824/20a7d9929c60c52ba269988a93221eec693b5b92.png"][/img]Thanks everyone![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Week Three Hot-Fix
notes.notes: [h1]Changes:[/h1][list][*][p][b]Capped the max speed bullets can travel[/b], there were cases where getting high powered cores with extra long barrels, bullets would travel too fast for accurate hit detection.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Penetration has had it's calculation reworked,[/b] high penetrating bullets have had a buff, and the difference between regular bullets and low penetration bullets is now greater.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ricochet bullets have had their bounce calculation tweaked, [/b]now when hitting obstacles they should bounce through them less, this should decrease their chances of destroying themselves by bouncing inside walls.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimisation changes to bullet generation,[/b] this will make it slightly faster to calculate when huge amounts of bullets are being shot at once, particularly with super fast cores.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Bug fixes:[/h1][list][*][p]Building from storage was checking if you had enough money to build that factory.[/p][/*][*][p]If you put a weapon factory into storage it wasn't getting rid of the old parts unless you built another factory after it.[/p][/*][*][p]Quitting a run and returning to the main menu wasn't resetting your current run kills or the timer.[/p][/*][*][p]Some localizations were set incorrectly in the build systems.[/p][/*][*][p]The localization for the active ability wasn't pulling the correct translation.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Week Three Patch!
notes.notes:
[h1]UI Overhaul:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936824/3cbc93cfaa840e8a41987e65812854b108c2ab01.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Rebuilt the player HUD[/b], this change has been in the works for a while now and we're happy to send it out, the player HUD now contains more information on what you have built in your guns as well as a huge amount of graphical updates.
[*] [b]Made the overall UI cleaner and more consistent in all menus.[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936824/8076eac5db8d8f363a5e4b7f3a9f2a42560919cd.jpg[/img]
[h1]Additions:[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Factory storage system implemented[/b], we got rid of the disable factory function and have implemented a system to store factories when you don't want them, this system means trying more builds will be easier.
[*] [b]New Achievements[/b], there are now achievements building for each manufacturers special gun.
[*] [b]Dodge ball[/b], added the Dodge Ball, we are working on a couple of more balls in the coming weeks too.
[/list]

[h1]Balance changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Decreased Health of first level heavy enemies[/b], They had the data from later level enemies and were too beefy,
[/list]

Thanks everyone!

notes.title: Week Two Patch!
notes.notes:
[h1]Additions:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Added a new calculation to the crate launcher,[/b] now if the crate launches really hard it wont have any angle applied to the launch, this will greatly decrease the chance of crates getting shot to unreachable places.
[*] [b]Level exit arrow[/b], now when getting close to one of the level exits around the map a small arrow will show up on the hud to indicate where an exit is.
[*] [b]Added a new gun explanation to the tutorial[/b], this will help explain the systems behind the gun building for new players.
[*] [b]Hotfix last week added a saftey catch for cloud save data, [/b] it should help limit save corruption if loading or saving gets interrupted.
[/list]

[h1]Balance changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Decreased health of second level boss[/b], we added way too much last update by accident it was only supposed to be 30% not 130%...
[*] [b]Decreased mass on level two and three enemies[/b], their mass was too high and was making it so only extremely high penetration bullets were passing through them, this will make the enemies on level three more manageable.
[*] [b]Decreased pushback from explosive bullets[/b], we've halved the amount of pushback the player receives from their own explosives, the heavy grenades have had their pushback decreased by 70%
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed multiple turret flies spawning on level start with only one fly launcher active.[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed timer not resetting on death.[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed ability trigger for when multiple charges are present[/b]. it was firing all charges at the same time making additional charges useless.
[*] [b]Fixed controller support in factory,[/b] hotfix from last week removed a reference enabling factory outlines.
[*] [b]Fixed turbo ball ability,[/b] it was not respecting modified cooldown or additional charges.
[*] [b]Fixed non-main guns firing logic,[/b] now all guns make full use of special cores and rotating barrel types.
[*] [b]Fixed tutorial UI breaking on controller after last hotfix.[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed loot ants not counting towards unlock requirements.[/b]
[*] [b]Various localisation issues.[/b]
[/list]

Thanks for the support everyone!

notes.title: Week one Patch!
notes.notes:
[h1]Additions:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Made mini boss type enemies[/b], mini boss enemies will spawn occasionally on each level now.
[/list]
[h1]Balance changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Increased health of second level boss[/b]
[*] [b]Increased health and mass for most enemies[/b], level three enemies were very weak compared to how strong the player is when they get there.
[*] [b]Increased health on ant mounds[/b], ant mounds were far too easy to kill and gave too good of a reward, it was a no brainer, now it's a more important decision whether to destroy them or not
[*] [b]Decreased health given from poop piles[/b], health returned was left over from when we had more total health on the balls, before we added ways to increase max HP.
[*] [b]Decreased drop chances for legendary parts[/b], they were shown too often in low level crates and in poop piles, came across legendries more often than epic in some cases.
[*] [b]Decreased damage of explosive bullets[/b], due to them being large bullet types they had high base damage but compounded with a huge area effect they were too powerful.
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed machine grub not shooting certain firing types properly[/b], now he makes use of fast fire rate cores too and has more consistent aim.
[*] [b]Fixed timer not carrying over to next level.[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed ability factory button not active for controllers.[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed factory outlines being disabled on first hover or select.[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed ability UI not showing in underground levels.[/b]
[/list]

Thanks everyone for your feedback, keep it coming.

notes.title: ACTIVE ROADMAP RELEASED!
notes.notes:
[h1]EA release build is up and roadmap has been released![/h1] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936824/ba5de485d1e11d476a324b4bafad8f79dd6f5e4d.png[/img]

[h2]BUILD 84.8 is active now![/h2]
This build contained so many bug fixes and balancing notes, here's some of the big ones:
[list]
[*][b]Save system adjustments[/b] - we've fixed an issue where it was always defaulting to the Steam cloud save, even if the local one was newer, should fix any lost progress if anyone has connection issues or like to play on the move on a Steam Deck.
[*][b]Added UI for the current equipped part[/b] - we realised people want more info on what's equipped in their current guns so we quickly made a UI system to show that, should make weapon upgrade decisions easier now.
[*][b]Made the achievements harder to get[/b] - the old achievements were far to easy to reach and didn't feel like an achievement, now some of them are way more challenging without being a slog.
[*][b]Full simplified Chinese localisation has been done[/b] - half of our development team is Chinese (there's only two of us) so this is a big milestone.
[/list]

123 different bullets.
143 different barrel types.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936824/abe4c2beee476ff444d88bfe87254f3b67ce98bf.png[/img]

Surface - Tunnels - Caverns
